01 / THE FIRST STORYLove. Loss. Everything between.

BETWEEN THESE PAGES

For the ones
we carry with us.

Ishan and Anya grow up together. Friendship becomes something neither quite knows how to name. When Anya is gone, Ishan is left with memories, unanswered questions, and the dreams they never finished.

The Sky She Left Me follows the quiet weight of grief—and the fragile possibility of finding purpose in what remains.

This novel explores bereavement and suicide.

A LINE TO KEEP

“You exist in my
every tomorrow.”

FROM THE SKY SHE LEFT ME

Nk.

THE AUTHOR

A piece of
Neha’s heart.

Neha Kharel is the author of The Sky She Left Me, her first novel, published in October 2025. In her author’s note, she describes writing it as a journey of emotions, reflection, and learning.

Her story gives space to the things we often leave unsaid: the tenderness of friendship, the ache of absence, and the love that continues after loss.

“This book is more than just words on paper. It is a piece of my heart.”
Neha Kharel
